method: STRIDE per boundary; every documented control is mapped to the module that implements it and the tests that pin it, or explicitly out-of-scope with a reason. The CI job (scripts/threat_model_check.py) fails when a mapped control loses its tests or when the document and this mapping drift apart.

threats.title: Issuing-side trust boundary: operator/gateway minting keys

controls.description: Signer abstraction with KMS/HSM backends so private keys need not live as disk PEM in production
Trust registry one-active-key-per-issuer-name rule acts as the impersonation control (rotation via versioned issuer identities)
Mixed-generation chains verify whole with all generations' public keys
Single-rooted trust: no multiparty mint in the current code (residual 1, mitigation M1 mint-time quorum)
controls.reason: Named future mitigation M1 (P0) in docs/threat-model/v1.md; no control exists yet, so there is nothing to pin

controls.description: Production signer assertion: a prod profile with RAUCLE_SIGNER unset runs local PEM silently (residual 2)
controls.reason: Named future mitigation M2 (P0) in docs/threat-model/v1.md; the startup assertion is not implemented yet

threats.title: Evidence boundary: receipt chain, verifier, SCITT anchor

controls.description: Hash chain + Merkle root + signed checkpoint for the receipt chain
Fail-closed offline verifier: strict alg/crit enforcement, no downgrade, named errors (ProvenanceVerifier)
Harness finding contract: findings split claim from truth and ghost citations fail named at verification
Anchor cadence automation, anchor-lag alarm and dual-notarisation (residual 3)
controls.reason: Named future mitigation M3 (P1) in docs/threat-model/v1.md

controls.description: Receipt-index INSERT OR REPLACE collapses byte-identical attempts; repair contract exists but operators who never rebuild undercount (residual 4)
controls.reason: Named future mitigation M4 (P2) in docs/threat-model/v1.md

controls.description: Gate chaos mode (S5): named fault injection (dropped receipts, delayed index writes, mis-ordered chain entries) proves the offline checks catch every evidence-write fault; off by default, refused outside DEV builds and behind any auth mode other than off

threats.title: Enforcement boundary: policy engine and approvals

controls.description: Fail-closed data-flow rules: deny on taint meeting an unallow-listed destination class and on unknown destinations even in evaluation mode
Approvals are receipted decisions
Unsigned policy/revocations/containment state: filesystem write equals control-plane takeover, no tamper detection on policy bytes today (residual 5, mitigation M5 seal-on-load)
controls.reason: Named future mitigation M5 (P0) in docs/threat-model/v1.md; the load path does not verify a seal yet

threats.title: Adoption boundary: the URL-switch gate proxy (passthrough)

controls.description: Server-side policy consultation on the real gateway engine, denies never reach the upstream, receipts minted for allow and deny, loopback-only default, hop-header stripping and origin-form checks
Passthrough trust assumption: upstream response content is not verified and streamed SSE bytes are not inspected (documented limitation)
controls.reason: Named residual in docs/threat-model/v1.md; output-side assurance stops at the passthrough wall until a post-hoc digest exists (M12)

controls.description: Upstream hostport pinned in the receipt so a verifier detects proxy/upstream drift
controls.reason: Named future mitigation M6 (P2) in docs/threat-model/v1.md

threats.title: Containment: the halt as asset and attack surface

controls.description: Every transition is a signed, auditable, reversible receipt; fail-closed rollback on receipt-emission failure; flock serialisation; named errors for malformed scope, missing prerequisites and double-holds
Unauthenticated operator authority: no quorum, no allowlist, no alerting on holds (residual 6, mitigation M7)
controls.reason: Named future mitigation M7 (P1) in docs/threat-model/v1.md

threats.title: Portal boundary (raucle-cloud): durable ingest queue and bounded rows

controls.description: Bounded-disclosure projection: no reason column at all, so deny reasons quoting constraint values cannot leak
controls.reason: raucle-cloud is the private line: the module and its tests live outside this OSS repository and cannot be pinned from here

controls.description: Stop-the-world recovery under chain re-ingest (residual 7, mitigation M8)
controls.reason: raucle-cloud is the private line, and the mitigation is future work (M8) in any case

controls.description: Silent skips during ingest need a counter column and reconciliation against the chain tail (residual 8, mitigation M9)
controls.reason: raucle-cloud is the private line, and the mitigation is future work (M9)

threats.title: Connector boundary (pulled data: Entra, Okta, GitHub audit)

controls.description: Injected transport with recorded fixtures; deterministic, spec-pinned mappings with a vector corpus against drift; vendor Retry-After carried on RateLimitError; opaque cursor paging with at-cursor dedupe; honest unknown attribution
Vendor-origin trust: connector events carry zero cryptographic binding to the source; cursor persistence is caller duty today (residual 10, mitigation M10)
controls.reason: Named future mitigation M10 (P2) in docs/threat-model/v1.md

threats.title: Bilateral outcomes and the executors' co-signature

controls.description: Closed outcome vocabulary enforced at emission and re-checked at verification; co-signature binds outcome, output hash and executor key id over canonical JSON
Executor keys through the KMS boundary and versioned-identity rotation (residual 11)
controls.reason: Named residual in docs/threat-model/v1.md; reuse of M2's startup assertion for executor signers is future work

threats.title: Red tooling and assurance console (evidence about evidence)

controls.description: Findings split claim from truth; exported artefacts never upgrade bad evidence (failed chains render failed, first line, non-zero exit)
Fence-aware docs-alignment checking of assurance docs
controls.reason: The checker exists only in open-agent-assurance; porting it to the OSS repo is named future work M11

residuals.title: TOTP secret stored in plaintext beside hashed API keys
residuals.reason: Protecting the secret needs a master-key source; deployment decision recorded 2026-11-08 in docs/threat-model/v1.md

residuals.title: Gate authentication default off is an explicit owner decision
residuals.reason: Owner decision 2026-11-08 kept off as shipped default for demo/back-compat; mitigations recorded (boot banner, /api/config, hardening checklist)

residuals.title: SIEM target validation does not resolve DNS
residuals.reason: Known residual; DNS resolution at config-write time is the candidate fix, egress allow-list is the deployment guidance; RAUCLE_SIEM_ALLOW_PRIVATE is the explicit opt-in

residuals.title: _FileCache same-size edit staleness
residuals.reason: Accepted residual: registries are operator-managed append-only files, so the risk needs a hostile in-place same-byte-length rewrite; M5 seal-on-load closes both this and R5
